(A) APDs received counts APDs received by the BLM and the APD Fee has been paid during the reporting period.

(B) APDs Pending includes cumulative APDs received without a final disposition. This includes the steps in the
process where the BLM is determining completeness of the application, or the Operator is addressing deficiencies such
as, Wildlife or Cultural Clearances, or the application is impacted by ongoing leasing litigation, and APDs awaiting
final decision.

(C) APDs Processed include APDs that are approved (column D), denied, returned, withdrawn, or cancelled.

(E) Available to drill are APDs that have been approved and are in their original two-year term or have had an
extension beyond the first two years not to exceed four years. This is the total on the date the report is generated. Once
an APD is drilled, expired or withdrawn, it is removed from the Approved and Available numbers.

(F) Fiscal Year Totals Cover 10/1/2022 to 09/30/2023
Individual State Office data includes APD activity for both Federal and Tribal lands
Data current as of 11/7/2023
The data in this report is accurate on the date it is pulled. Changes to previously reported numbers may result from
ongoing data quality control reviews.

(A) APDs received counts APDs received by the BLM and the APD Fee has been paid during the reporting period.

(B) APDs Pending includes cumulative APDs received without a final disposition. This includes the steps in the
process where the BLM is determining completeness of the application, or the Operator is addressing deficiencies
such as, Wildlife or Cultural Clearances, or the application is impacted by ongoing leasing litigation, and APDs
awaiting final decision.

(C) APDs Processed include APDs that are approved (column D), denied, returned, withdrawn, or cancelled.

(E) Available to drill are APDs that have been approved and are in their original two-year term or have had an
extension beyond the first two years not to exceed four years. This is the total on the date the report is generated.
Once an APD is drilled, expired or withdrawn, it is removed from the Approved and Available numbers.
